Name: (CF) Kvoor's Legendary Fish Plaques
Author: Kvoor
Description:
Here's a furniture mod that[u] does not[/u] replace anything in the game, the legendary fish as plaques! They're their own unique items added in for your fun and love for fishing. Couldn't have done it without [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/platonymous.763992/]Platonymous[/url]' mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254/?]Custom Furniture. [color=#ffffff]Be sure to check him out and his other mods~!
[/color][/url][size=3][center][u]
[b]NOTE: YOU MUST DOWNLOAD THE UNOFFICIAL PATCH HERE:[/b][/u] [url=https://smapi.io/mods/]https://smapi.io/mods/[/url] [b][u]FOR CUSTOM FURNITURE IN ORDER FOR THIS TO CONTINUE WORKING!!![/u][/b][/center][/size]
Installation Instructions:
1.) Download the Custom Furniture mod and PyTK via Vortex or manually
2.) Download this mod either via Vortex or manually; if manually- copy/cut and paste into your mod folder
3.) If all goes well you should see it in your furniture catalog and Robin's Shop!

I wanted to make this a craftable but sadly it is not and I cannot figure it out for my coding skills are sub-par so I apologize for the lack of awesomeness in the mod, it's just a simple "painting".
Feel free to share this on other sites or expand upon it as long as you credit me!
